result.description: Entelso  We are seeking a motivated  Telecommunications Network Engineer  to support the engineering, integration and optimisation of telecommunications networks across multiple projects in Australia.  This role involves supporting the planning, engineering implementation and monitoring of telecommunications network solutions, ensuring network performance and reliability while complying with Australian standards, regulatory requirements and industry best practices. The successful candidate will contribute to RF network design, system integration, network commissioning, testing and ongoing performance optimisation across multi-operator carrier and in-building environments.  The position supports to the engineering delivery of wireless network deployments involving major mobile operators such as Telstra, Optus and Vodafone, supporting integration, validation and technical documentation activities across indoor and macro network projects.   Benefits   Competitive salary aligned with skills and industry experience.  Opportunity to contribute to RF, DAS and wireless network projects across major Australian carrier environments (Telstra, Optus and Vodafone).  Exposure to interstate telecommunications deployments and multi-site engineering activities.  Ongoing professional development within a specialised telecommunications engineering team.    Task & responsibilities   Contribute to the integration, optimisation and performance monitoring of telecommunications network systems across RF and in-building wireless environments.  Support testing, commissioning and validation of 4G, 5G and legacy cellular technologies to ensure network performance targets are achieved.  Conduct RF performance analysis and contribute to troubleshooting activities under engineering supervision.  Prepare technical documentation, site records and engineering reports in line with Australian standards and project requirements.  Collaborate with project engineers, vendors and field technicians to maintain network reliability, compliance and service quality.  Participate in continuous improvement initiatives related to network performance and system optimisation.    Qualification & experience   Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications Engineering or related discipline.  3+ years of hands-on experience in telecommunications network engineering, including RF systems and in-building coverage environments.   Demonstrated application of telecommunications engineering principles including system integration, performance evaluation and network optimisation within carrier-grade environments.  Proven experience in telecommunications network engineering within RF and in-building environments.  Strong knowledge of LTE (4G), 5G NR and Wi-Fi, with understanding of legacy cellular technologies.  Experience with In-Building Coverage (IBC), repeater systems and Distributed Antenna Systems (DAS).  Experience using RF performance analysis and data collection tools such as TEMS, NEMO and GIS/RF planning tools (MapInfo, iBwave or similar).  Proficiency with RF test and measurement equipment, including spectrum analysers, RF scanners, RF signal generators, and cable and antenna testing equipment.  Demonstrated application of RF engineering principles including link budget calculations and system performance evaluation.  Ability to produce technical documentation using engineering design tools (Visio or similar).   About Company     Entelso Pty Ltd is an Australian telecommunications solutions provider specialising in network design, RF engineering and in-building coverage solutions across carrier and enterprise environments. We design and implement wireless connectivity solutions supporting major Australian mobile network operators including Telstra, Optus and Vodafone,   delivered through established supply chain partners.    The company provides nationwide delivery capability across telecommunications infrastructure projects, including Distributed Antenna Systems (DAS), repeater technologies and network optimisation solutions.
